{{Top|leg}}
The '''Count of Gesl''' was a noble title of [[Irmenu]]. In the decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was held by [[Walon Vau]]'s [[Walon Vau's father|father]]. Walon would have inherited the title, but was disowned by his family after a doomed love affair with the [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of a neighboring province led to his [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] from Irmenu by the [[Imperius]] priesthood. After Vau joined the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], his [[Walon Vau's cousin|cousin]] assumed the title.

Despite the aversion of the Irmenu to offworld contact, the Counts of Gesl maintained a bank vault in the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]] on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] to store the family fortune. Many years after his exile during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Walon Vau plundered the vault to regain his inheritance.
